shortSegments.description: A woman hugs a man sitting in the driver's seat of a car, holding a board with needles behind his back.
A close-up of a hand placing a blanket over the board of needles on a car seat.
Close-up of the woman hugging the man, talking with an emotional expression.
A hand adjusts the blanket covering the needle board in the back seat.
A close-up shot of the woman embracing the man in the car from a different angle.
The woman steps back from the car, talking to the man who is about to drive off.
A close-up of a hand pressing down on the blanket and the needle board.
The woman talks excitedly to the man in the car, pretending she forgot something.
The man in the car smiles and prepares to drive away.
Wide shot of the woman standing on the sidewalk watching the car drive off.
Medium shot of the woman standing outdoors with arms crossed, talking to the camera.
A blonde woman in a white shirt and grey skirt limps down the sidewalk in pain.
The brunette woman watches the blonde woman limping away in the background.
The blonde woman continues limping and talking to the brunette woman outdoors.
The two women talk to each other on the street, the brunette announcing she is pregnant.
Interior shot of a dinner party where people are seated around a table and laughing.
The brunette woman stands up at the dinner table holding a glass of juice.
The brunette woman makes an announcement at the dinner table about her pregnancy.
Close-up of a man at the dinner table reacting to the announcement.
Another man at the table reacts angrily, speaking to the group.
The man puts something into his pocket while talking.
The brunette woman reacts emotionally, holding her head and talking.
A man walks away towards a door in the indoor setting.
Another man touches his head in frustration indoors.
The brunette woman holds a small electronic device and looks at it.
A man looks down with a serious expression at the table.
Close-up of a small transmitter device held in someone's hand.
